confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Busan price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, beer and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation is less certain given July peak-season and Haeundae rate swings. Cocktail and wine_glass use the beer relationship (roughly two to two-and-a-half times the beer example) because direct knowledge is weaker. Local-currency examples assume about 1,400 KRW per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional East Asian basis: a mid-to-large South Korean port city priced below Seoul, with dining and budget-to-mid hotel levels broadly comparable to Fukuoka; no named listings were checked.

anchor_basis.beer: 500 ml draft or bottled domestic beer at a Busan restaurant, about 6,000 KRW
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a neighborhood cafe in Seomyeon or Haeundae, about 5,500 KRW
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: pork-rice soup (dwaeji gukbap) at a local eatery, about 10,000 KRW
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two at a mid-range restaurant in Haeundae or Seomyeon, about 120,000 KRW total
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a neighborhood bar in Seomyeon or Gwangalli, about 14,000 KRW
anchor_basis.wine_glass: glass of house wine at a wine bar or restaurant, about 12,000 KRW
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: dorm bed in a registered hostel in Nampo or Haeundae, July rate, about 35,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel or guesthouse, July rate, about 70,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic registered yeogwan (budget motel) double room, about 60,000 KRW per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: registered three-star business hotel double room in Seomyeon or Haeundae, July rate, about 170,000 KRW per night
